stories.title: Sydney Sweeney "knows ball" in Novig's near-nude ad
stories.summary: Sports prediction app Novig posted its "Just Sports" ad with Sydney Sweeney posing nearly nude with footballs, a basketball and a pool table, captioned "Confirmed: Sydney Sweeney knows ball." By her birthday on Sep 12 it was on a Times Square billboard and women in sports media were criticizing it. The top quote of the billboard photo got 465K likes.
